# Emaillistverify

EmailListVerify is a service that provides email verification and validation to ensure email lists are clean and deliverable.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/emaillistverify/.

## Actions

- **Verify Email** (read-only): Verify a single email address in real time.
- **Verify Email Detailed** (read-only): Verify a single email address and return detailed validation information.
